problems.quote: Section `[modules.enhanced_ai_leader_loot]` in `config/vanillaplusadditions-common.toml` (or `config/vpa_enhanced_ai_leader_loot-common.toml` if you run the standalone jar).
problems.issue: This module has no standalone jar, so `config/vpa_enhanced_ai_leader_loot-common.toml` can never exist. build.gradle's standaloneModules list contains no entry for it (grep -c enhanced_ai_leader_loot build.gradle = 0, there is no standalone/enhanced_ai_leader_loot package), and the same page contradicts the sentence twice: the meta block says 'Download | bundle only - no standalone jar' and the limits table says 'Standalone jars | There is none.'. The sentence is generator boilerplate emitted unconditionally by scripts/docgen/gen_meta.py:128-132 (config_block), which - unlike meta_block at gen_meta.py:105-111 - never looks at facts['hasStandaloneJar']. 6 of 48 module pages are affected the same way.
problems.correction: Do NOT hand-edit the page here: the text sits between <!-- vpa:config:start --> and <!-- vpa:config:end --> and `python3 scripts/docgen/gen_meta.py --check` (CI) would flag it as stale. Fix the generator instead: in scripts/docgen/gen_meta.py config_block(), take the facts dict and emit the '(or `config/vpa_<id>-common.toml` if you run the standalone jar)' clause only when facts['hasStandaloneJar'] is true; then regenerate the blocks. Resulting sentence for this module: 'Section `[modules.enhanced_ai_leader_loot]` in `config/vanillaplusadditions-common.toml`.'

problems.quote: It is still registered, still writes its config section and still appears in `/vpa module status`, and nothing warns you: `enhancedai` is not declared in `neoforge.mods.toml`, the gate is runtime only.
problems.issue: Minor overstatement. The 'no declared dependency, no NeoForge missing-dependency error' half is correct (grep for 'enhancedai' in src/main/resources finds nothing; EnhancedAiLeaderLootModule.java:46-49 is the only gate), but 'nothing warns you' is not literally true: AbstractModule.initialize logs one line at INFO when the gate fails - AbstractModule.java:96-99, `logger.info("Module '{}' is disabled and will not be initialized", displayName)`. So the server log does say something; it is just at INFO and worded as 'disabled' rather than 'Enhanced AI missing'.
problems.correction: Soften to something like: 'and nothing really warns you - `enhancedai` is not declared in `neoforge.mods.toml`, so NeoForge never complains; the only trace is one INFO line at startup, "Module 'Enhanced AI Leader Loot' is disabled and will not be initialized", which blames the module rather than the missing mod.'

sourceBugs: EnhancedAiLeaderLootModule.java:30 - the class javadoc says "See {@code docs/enhanced_ai_leader_loot.md} for how this was reverse-engineered." That path no longer exists; the page was moved to docs/modules/enhanced_ai_leader_loot.md (staged rename). Same stale path in CLAUDE.md:94 (not Java, but the same rename).

core/AbstractModule.java:97 - `logger.info("Module '{}' is disabled and will not be initialized", displayName)` fires for every false shouldInitialize(), including the missing-optional-mod case used here, so a player without Enhanced AI is told the module is 'disabled' when it is really unavailable. Wording bug, not a functional one.
